inclusions.text: Admission to the temples (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)
inclusions.source: The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (return flights, private transfers, guide, water, and all logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus admission to the temples); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).
